critical_code_review_comments: log_assignment(): when action='auto_returned' the 'driver' arg is passed as current_user (the driver toggling unavailable), so driver_id/driver_name correctly identify the abeja whose order is being returned. Good.

PATCH /api/drivers/availability is keyed off the driver token (not order_id), so a malicious driver flipping availability rapidly could spam auto-return events. Consider de-duplicating identical (order_id, action) events within the same second to avoid log noise.
GET /api/admin/assignment-history caps limit at 200 (good). No pagination/cursor — fine for now but consider indexed range queries if history grows beyond a few thousand events.

Frontend AdminDashboard.js fetches /admin/assignment-history with .then().catch(() => {}) AFTER Promise.all — meaning history loads slightly later than the rest of the panel. Acceptable UX, but a transient blank state until the second fetch resolves. Could be inlined into the Promise.all for atomic refresh.

Driver name 'Repartidor Real' is shown without the bee icon prefix in some rows while 'Abeja Madrid' shows '🐝 Abeja Madrid' (icon comes from template '🐝 {ev.driver_name}'); inconsistent because seeded driver.real name does not start with 'Abeja '. Purely cosmetic.
Carry-over from iteration_7: 'Abejas activas: 9' vs '7 abejas en ruta' header inconsistency still present (not related to this feature).
